content: Aylletas Imetida Zore
Xoossaa sunthaynne nu timirtey cayetonna mela aylletethan de7eysati bantana haariya godata boncho.

Ammaniya godati de7iya aylleti, enta godati entaw isha gidiya gisho enta kadhopo. Enta oosuwan maadetiya godati, ammaneysatanne dosetidaysata gidiya gisho enti kasepe aathidi oothanaw bessees. Neeni haysa tamaarsanawunne enti oothana mela zoranaw bessees.
Tuma Duretethi
Oonika dumma timirte tamaarsiyaba gidiko, nu Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosa tuma qaalaranne nu ammano timirtiyara gahetenna.
He uray otoron sugeteesipe attishin, aykoka erenna. Entaw issi qofa bolla palamanawunne ooyetanaw iita amoy de7ees. Hessi qanaate, ooshshi, cashshe, iita sidhenne,
giigonna palama kaalethees. Qassi entaw iita wozani de7ees; tumaa balidosona; enti Xoossaa ammanoy duretethas oge gidi qopoosona.
Shin taw de7iyabay gidana giya asas tuma ayyaana de7oy gita wodhe.
Nuuni ha alamiya aykoka ehibooko; qassi iyape aykoka ekidi booko.
Nuus kathinne ma7oy de7iko hessi gidana.
Shin duretethi koyeysati paaceninne xihen geloosona. Qassi entana duge dafiyanne dhaysiya eeyatethinne qohiya amon kundoosona.
Miishe siiqoy iitatetha ubbaas pulto. Issoti issoti miishe amotishe ammanope baletidi daro meton bantana yeggidosona.
Zorenne Kiita
Shin neno, Xoossa aso, hessafe baqata. Xillotethaa, Xoossaa daano, ammano, siiqo, danda7anne ashketethi kaalla.
Ammano baaxiya loytha baaxeta. Daro asaa sinthan ne markatida ne ammanuwaba, Xoossay nena iyaw xeegida merinaa de7uwa oyka.
Ubbaas de7o immiya Xoossaa sinthaninne, Phenxe Philaxoosa sinthan lo77o marka markatida Kiristoos Yesuusa sinthan ta nena kiittayis.
Nu Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosi qoncana gakanaw ha kiitaa balinne borey bayna naaga.
Ba xalaala ubbaa haariya boncho Xoossay, kawota kawoy, godata Goday, ba qopida qamman Yesuus Kiristoosa zaari kiittana.
Issi iya xalaali hayqenna. Oonika shiiqanaw danda7onna poo7on de7ees. Oonika iya be7ibeenna; qassi be7anawuka danda7enna. Bonchoynne merinaa wolqay iyaw gido. Amin7i.
Ha alamiya dureti coo dhayiya shalon otortonna melanne ceeqonna mela oda. Nuus koshshiyaba palahisidi immiya nuna anjiya, dure Xoossan ammanetana mela enta kiitta.
Enti lo77o ooso oothanaada lo77o ooson duretanaada, keehatanne haratas shaakeyisata gidana mela kiitta.
Hessi entaw sinthas mino baaso gidiya gisho, he wode enti tuma de7oy ay daaniyako erana.
Ximotiyoosa, issi issi asay, “Eratethi” giya eeya palamapenne hada odape baqata; new imetida hadara naaga.
Issoti issoti nuus eratethi de7ees yaagishe ammanuwa aggidosona. Xoossaa aadho keehatethay hinte ubbaara gido.
